#!/bin/bash
set -e -x

TRAIN_SCRIPT=/root/contamcal-irt-calibration/exp001/train_sft.py
DATA_DIR=/root/autodl-tmp/sft_data
CKPT_DIR=/root/autodl-tmp/exp001/checkpoints
MODEL=/root/autodl-tmp/models/Qwen2.5-14B

export CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=1

OUTDIR="${CKPT_DIR}/Qwen2.5-14B_d050_s0"

# Clean up empty adapter dir from failed sweep
rm -rf "${OUTDIR}/lora_adapter"

echo "=== Starting Qwen2.5-14B d050 s0 (with gradient_checkpointing) at $(date) ==="
HF_DATASETS_OFFLINE=1 HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1 \
/root/miniconda3/bin/python "$TRAIN_SCRIPT" \
  --model-name "$MODEL" \
  --data-path "${DATA_DIR}/sft_dosage_050.jsonl" \
  --output-dir "$OUTDIR" \
  --seed 0 \
  --lora-r 16 --lora-alpha 32 --lr 5e-5 \
  --batch-size 1 --grad-accum 16 \
  --gradient-checkpointing
echo "=== Finished Qwen2.5-14B d050 s0 at $(date), exit code=$? ==="

# Verify adapter saved
if [ ! -f "${OUTDIR}/lora_adapter/adapter_model.safetensors" ]; then
  echo "FATAL: adapter_model.safetensors not found after training!"
  exit 1
fi
echo "SUCCESS: adapter verified at ${OUTDIR}/lora_adapter/adapter_model.safetensors"
SCRIPT_EOF
chmod +x /root/contamcal-irt-calibration/scripts/seed0/retrain_qwen14b_d050_s0.sh
